AUTHOR: Bürgi
TITLE: Towards a fully automated underwater census for fish assemblages in the Mediterranean Sea
REGION: French Riviera, NW Mediterranean (France); test at Cap Roux and Corniche Varoise
SPECIES: 19 Mediterranean fish species (e.g., Sarpa salpa, Diplodus vulgaris, Epinephelus marginatus, Mullus surmuletus) + 'Other'
DATA: Own diver-operated GoPro transect videos: DATAT (2022, 8 locations, 131 train / 47 test videos, 13,033 images) and DATAE (Oct 2023, 64 transects, 14 sites); pretraining on DeepFish and OzFish
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The depth ranged from 1 to 37 m and was carried out during the whole year in 2022 (cold and warm season)'
D2: DATAT: 131 training videos / 47 independent test videos (40,379/28,194 labels); separate DATAE for transect evaluation
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: '13,033 images (131 videos in the training set and 47 independent videos in the test set)'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The experimental dataset (DATAE) was recorded in October 2023 in and around two protected areas' vs training data gathered in 2022 at eight locations.
C_EV: Sec. 3.2/Table 2: loose (0.05), balanced (0.60), strict (0.80) thresholds compared; 'The DL detections were double checked for the strict case'; 45 FPs reported.
E_EV: Sec. 3.3: transect presence/absence and species richness compared with manual video counts and diver UVC; 'the average species richness per site over rocky substrates is 7.88 for the manual video count and 9.12 for the traditional UVC'
ARCH: YOLOv7 (benchmarked vs Fast/Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLOv10); UIEC2-Net colour correction
METR: mAP, precision, recall, F1; transect accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, AUC, Cohen's kappa, TSS
NOTE: Headline transect evaluation on DATAE (different year and sites from training) -> R1=Y (복수: year + site). R3 coded N because in-domain results are frame-level detection metrics (mAP 0.56, P 0.78, R 0.60) while external results are transect-level presence/absence metrics, so no like-for-like performance change; a verifier might code R3=Y under 'both reported numerically'. Kappa/TSS agreement is vs manual video count (same footage); comparison with diver UVC is via species richness and Venn diagrams (independent reference). COCO pretraining then DeepFish/OzFish pretraining (fish-only) before fine-tuning. V1 coded NR: 'wide range of conditions in the videos' does not mention visibility/turbidity explicitly. ENV: seagrass (Posidonia) + rocky substrates.
